name: Wildlife Explorer
description: Explore animal habitats and discover incredible creatures!

reward.name: Jaguar
reward.fact: Jaguars have the strongest bite of any big cat and love swimming in rivers.

reward.name: Dolphin
reward.fact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open and half their brain awake to watch for danger.

reward.name: Lion
reward.fact: A lion's roar can be heard from five miles away across the savannah.

reward.name: Polar Bear
reward.fact: Polar bears have black skin under their white fur to help absorb heat from the sun.

reward.name: Poison Dart Frog
reward.fact: Poison dart frogs get their toxins from the insects they eat in the rainforest.

reward.name: Fennec Fox
reward.fact: Fennec foxes have huge ears that help them hear prey underground and keep cool in the desert heat.

reward.name: Snow Leopard
reward.fact: Snow leopards can leap up to 15 metres in a single bound across mountain gaps.

reward.name: Cheetah
reward.fact: Cheetahs are the fastest land animals and can run at 70 miles per hour.

reward.name: Hippo
reward.fact: Hippos can hold their breath underwater for up to 5 minutes — that's like holding your breath for a whole TV advert break!

reward.name: Sea Turtle
reward.fact: Sea turtles can live for over 100 years and travel thousands of miles across the ocean every year.

reward.name: Red Panda
reward.fact: Red pandas wrap their fluffy tails around themselves like a blanket to keep warm in the mountains.

reward.name: Crocodile
reward.fact: Crocodiles have been on Earth for over 200 million years — they lived alongside the dinosaurs!

reward.name: Toucan
reward.fact: A toucan's colourful beak can be one third of its entire body length — that's like your nose being as long as your arm!

reward.name: Meerkat
reward.fact: Meerkats take turns standing guard while others eat. The lookout stands on its back legs and barks if danger is near.

reward.name: Starfish
reward.fact: If a starfish loses an arm, it can grow a brand new one! Some can even grow a whole new body from just one arm.

reward.name: Heron
reward.fact: Herons stand completely still for ages waiting for fish, then strike in a tenth of a second — faster than you can blink!

reward.name: Kingfisher
reward.fact: Kingfishers dive into water at up to 25 miles per hour to catch fish — and they hardly make a splash!

reward.name: Hedgehog
reward.fact: Hedgehogs have about 5,000 spines on their back. Each spine lasts about a year before falling out and being replaced.

reward.name: Dragonfly
reward.fact: Dragonflies have been on Earth for 300 million years and can fly in any direction — even backwards!

reward.name: Arctic Fox
reward.fact: Arctic foxes change colour with the seasons — white in winter to hide in snow, brown in summer to blend with rocks.

reward.name: Komodo Dragon
reward.fact: Komodo dragons are the largest lizards in the world and can smell prey from nearly 10 kilometres away.

reward.name: Giant Squid
reward.fact: Giant squid have the largest eyes in the animal kingdom — each one is the size of a dinner plate!

reward.name: Pangolin
reward.fact: Pangolins are the only mammals covered in scales. When scared, they curl into a tight ball that even lions can't open.

reward.name: Beaver
reward.fact: Beavers build dams that can be over 800 metres long — the largest structures built by any animal other than humans.

reward.name: Wildebeest
reward.fact: Every year, over 1.5 million wildebeest travel 1,800 miles across Africa — the largest animal migration on Earth.

reward.name: Golden Eagle
reward.fact: Golden eagles have eyesight 8 times sharper than humans — they can spot a rabbit from over 3 kilometres away!

reward.name: Camel
reward.fact: Camels can drink up to 200 litres of water in just 3 minutes — that's like filling a whole bathtub!

reward.name: Snowy Owl
reward.fact: Snowy owls have feathers on their feet to keep warm. They can turn their heads almost all the way round — 270 degrees!

reward.name: Manatee
reward.fact: Manatees are sometimes called sea cows. They spend 6-8 hours a day eating seagrass and can weigh over 500 kilograms!

reward.name: Orangutan
reward.fact: Orangutans share 97% of their DNA with humans. They're one of the smartest animals on Earth and can use tools!

reward.name: Giraffe
reward.fact: Giraffes are the tallest animals on Earth at up to 5.5 metres. Their tongues are about 50 centimetres long and are purple!

reward.name: Monarch Butterfly
reward.fact: Monarch butterflies travel up to 4,800 kilometres every year — and they weigh less than a paperclip!
